text:
Maya (People Ops): :wave: New pilot live today: Family Support Advance and a short Travel Conduct acknowledgement for company-funded visits. Short summary + links below.

Olu (People Ops): TL;DR: one-time Family Support Advance up to $1,800 for urgent caregiving or family emergency travel/expenses; expedited reviews before 2pm PT. Repayment options: payroll spread, card charge, or case-by-case grant conversion.

Alex (Eng): Does this cover emergency childcare while I travel for a funeral?

Maya (People Ops): Yes 100%. Eligible uses include last-minute childcare, eldercare, urgent flights for immediate family, and related expedite fees. Attach itinerary or provider note.

Cam (Finance): Coding will be "Family Support Advance" for <$1.8k. Tax treatment: some regions may require withholding; we'll show tax implications on the form and offer gross-up where policy applies.

Ruth (Security): New process note: any company-funded customer visit or sponsored on-site activation requires a short Travel Conduct acknowledgement during preapproval. Expenses or bookings will be held until ack is completed.

Alex (Eng): If someone has a religious or medical objection to the acknowledgement, what's the path?

Olu (People Ops): DM People Ops for an accommodation. We'll provide an alternate review that doesn't block travel if approved.

peopleops-bot: Reminder set: "Travel conduct ack" will ping attendees 7 days before travel and again 48 hours prior.

Maya (People Ops): Apply here: https://forms.redwood/family-support-advance. FAQ and tax notes: https://docs.redwood/internal/family-support. Quick AMA tomorrow 9:00am PT in #people-ops-ama. For private help, DM us or reply here and we'll route to a confidential review.

Cam (Finance): If you want a sample repayment schedule before applying, reply and I'll post an example spreadsheet.

Alex (Eng): Appreciate this, makes emergency planning much easier.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all 14 we'll monitor pilot metrics and share results after 3 months.
